records.title: ux(vscode): editor and context menus, default keybindings, and manifest contract tests
records.release_claim: common status and repair commands are discoverable from editor context menus and default keybindings
records.reason: Useful first-use affordance, but independently deferrable if packaged extension docs preserve the palette and code-action paths honestly.
records.non_claim: VS Code exposes no diagnostic-source context key, so menu gating remains language/context based rather than proof of a RIPR diagnostic target.
